summary: Iteration 12: full backend + frontend validation of the new admin feature set (2-step email 2FA login, admin account update, editable site settings, provider filters, visitor analytics, newsletter subscribe/admin CRUD/notify, unsubscribe link). Backend: 14/14 pytest passed in /app/backend/tests/test_iter12_new_features.py (2FA happy+error paths, used-challenge -> 400, wrong-code -> 401, account password rotate-and-restore, settings persist+public GET+reset to empty, /track responds <1s and geolocation backfills country/city in background, /admin/analytics groups by session with pages+total_duration+auth-required, subscribe idempotent + admin add/toggle/delete + unsubscribe HTML page + duplicate -> 400, notify article & event queue and return {ok, queued}, 404 for missing article). Frontend: admin two-step login UI works (data-testid admin-2fa-input reached, 6-digit code from mongo verified, redirect to /admin/dashboard), provider filters (filter-country/region/category/clear/count) narrow list correctly (462 shown -> 0 after picking rare country -> 462 after clear), Analytics tab renders analytics-session-0 rows expandable, Subscribers tab add/toggle-active/delete works end-to-end with confirmation dialog, notify-articles-0 & notify-events-0 buttons render with confirm-notify-btn alert dialog, Settings tab shows settings-manager + account-current-password + save buttons; saving hero_heading='TEST_HERO_UI' and facebook_url reflected on Home hero AND Footer facebook link, then reset back to empty (verified via GET /api/settings all empty). Newsletter modal auto-shows on /blog after ~1.4s, subscribing sets hl_subscribed=1. All test-created subscribers and settings values cleaned up.

critical.issue: When Emergent-managed Resend hits its rate limit (HTTP 429), /api/auth/login raises 502 and the admin is completely locked out of the portal (no way to bypass because 2FA is required on EVERY login). Observed during test run after ~10 rapid logins during pytest; recovered after ~3 minute cooldown. Consider (a) caching a valid challenge for a short window and reusing it if the user retries within N seconds, (b) exponential backoff/retry inside send_email, or (c) an emergency backup code / SMTP fallback so a Resend outage does not brick the admin.

action_items: Harden /api/auth/login against Resend 429s so admin isn't locked out (see backend_issues.critical). Options: retry with jitter, allow reuse of a still-fresh challenge if login is called again with same creds, or a persistent secondary email transport.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py _send_newsletter iterates active subscribers and awaits send_email with only a 0.4s sleep between sends — for large lists this both (a) can hit Resend rate limits and (b) blocks the background task for a long time. Consider batching / using a worker queue and continuing past 429 with retry-after.

server.py /api/auth/verify-2fa stores the 6-digit code in PLAINTEXT (db.auth_challenges.code) for testability. This is documented in test_credentials.md but is still a security smell — an attacker with read access to the DB can bypass 2FA. Consider hashing the code (bcrypt/argon2) and only comparing hashes; test harness can be adapted with a debug endpoint gated behind an env flag.

server.py login endpoint inserts a new auth_challenges row on EVERY login attempt but does not invalidate prior unused challenges for the same user. If the admin clicks Continue twice they will get two emails and either code will log in. Consider expiring older unused challenges on new login.

AdminDashboard.jsx: filter-country dropdown lists all 13 ISLANDS regardless of whether providers exist for them (picking a rare country -> '0 shown'). Purely cosmetic; could restrict to countries with providers to prevent empty-state confusion.
server.py /admin/analytics loads up to 3000 most-recent visits into memory and groups client-side. Fine for now; will need pagination/aggregation pipeline when traffic grows.

NewsletterModal shows after ~1.4s on every visit until subscribed — user request confirmed this behavior. Acceptable, but consider a session-level 'dismissed' flag to avoid nagging within the same session even if hl_subscribed is not set.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression: pytest /app/backend/tests/test_iter12_new_features.py -v (runs ~11s, 14 tests). Do NOT log in more than ~5-6 times in quick succession from tests OR you will trip Resend's 429 rate limit and lock out the admin (~3 min cooldown). Prefer obtaining a JWT once via curl and reusing it for playwright tests via localStorage.setItem('hl_token', <token>) then navigating to /admin/dashboard — this is what was used here to avoid burning emails. 2FA code is stored plaintext at db.auth_challenges.findOne({challenge:'<x>'}).code and can be read via mongosh.
rca of the issue: When Emergent Resend replied 429 Too Many Requests, backend send_email raised, /auth/login caught it and returned HTTPException 502 'Could not send your verification code.' Because 2FA is enforced on every admin login and there is no backup transport or challenge-reuse, the portal becomes unusable until the upstream cooldown clears (~3 min in our test). Reproduction: run pytest test_iter12_new_features.py twice back-to-back, then attempt to log in from the UI -> Cloudflare-mediated 502 shown; wait ~3 min and login succeeds normally. Mitigation options listed under action_items.
